title: Industrial AI Quality Inspection Based on IndustryGPT Multimodal Industrial Large Model
summary: SmartMore reports that an IndustryGPT example reached 100% accuracy in 5:27, compared with 50% in 9:31 for manual training. These are technical test results.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: SmartMore reports that an IndustryGPT example reached 100% accuracy in 5:27, compared with 50% in 9:31 for manual training. These are technical test results. The chapter also describes commercial production-line applications. The quoted accuracy and timing figures belong to a technical comparison, not a measured customer financial return.
purpose: Simplify industrial inspection-model development and improve defect detection.

ratings.reason: The source's model-training example reports 100% accuracy and recall versus 50% accuracy and 66.7% recall with manual training, alongside shorter training time. The rated gain is technical capability, not production revenue.

ai_role.statement: IndustryGPT converts natural-language requests into model-development steps on the ViMo platform, including annotation, tuning, and training. The quoted result is a technical comparison.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
